description: [Free] Your PRIVATE bank: every image, clip and audio file, by origin and subject, with id, URL, brief, tags and facets. Reuse a picture by putting its id in an image scene as data.asset_id (a clip resolves to clipUrl by itself); an audio asset is a film's music as "asset:<id>". Reusing costs no credit.
